name: multiref_v1
set: development - the nine benchmark speakers; never a test set
generation_budget: each engine's configured defaults in configs/default.yaml at the commit that renders; identical across conditions
reference_transcripts: the corpus transcripts of whole clips; a multi prompt uses the two joined with a space, in clip order

contrasts.multi-YZ vs single-A: about the same length; different source clips
contrasts.multi-YZ vs single-Y: same first clip; about twice the length

rules: no clip in any condition's prompt is ever in that speaker's evaluation_clips
every condition of a speaker is scored against the same evaluation_clips
an engine is not run on a condition listed in inapplicable_for_engine; the prompt is never cut to fit, because that would be a different condition
known_limits: equal speech budgets need cuts inside utterances, which the corpus cannot support with exact transcripts; lengths are matched on whole clips within 15% instead
two evaluation clips per speaker instead of the benchmark's four, so held-out scores here are noisier than the benchmark's and not comparable to them
